species.real: In the tale of Llyn y Fan Fach, a fairy wife from the lake leaves her husband after he strikes her three times without cause, and their sons become the healers known as the Physicians of Myddfai.
species.name: Tylwyth

dex.text: Lives beneath the lake and under the hill, and only comes up when it can be bothered. Its gifts are always a little too generous.
dex.fact: Tylwyth Teg means 'the fair family' in Welsh, a polite name for the fairies.
